'''2002 Bespin Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG regional in June 2002. [[Josh Kohman]] won it. It is known from Josh Kohman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3755">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-17-bespin-regionals-kohman-brings-a-broomd3755/ bespin-regionals-kohman-brings-a-broom], DeckTech (Josh-e-poo "supaposhjosh" Kohman, 17 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-17-bespin-regionals-kohman-brings-a-broomd3755/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' June 2002
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Players:''' 42 (Saturday main event)<ref name="pc-bruun02">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030613110815/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/duane2002yearend.htm The State Of SWCCG], Duane Bruun (PC Staff Writer), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 13 June 2003.</ref>
* '''Organizer:''' [[Nick Kolnik]]<ref name="pc-bruun02" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Josh Kohman]]

Duane Bruun's year-end article for the Players Committee says Kolnik "ran an extremely successful weekend event": 42 players in Saturday's main event and 32 in a Friday night sealed deck tournament.<ref name="pc-bruun02" /> Kolnik later wrote that 11 of the 42 participants were from out of state and none of them placed higher than 9th.<ref name="pc-mnweekend">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030822034604/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/mnstatesweekend04182003.htm The 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 August 2003.</ref> About 30 players had pre-registered for the event.<ref name="pcf-1291-23802">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23802#23802 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
